(rule!
  (let* ((h (rows g)) (w (cols g)) (bg (mode g -1))
         (body (mode-list (filter (lambda (v) (!= v bg)) (row g 0))))
         (cs (filter (lambda (c) (= (at g 0 c) body)) (range w)))
         (tip (find-first (lambda (v) (and (!= v bg) (!= v body)))
                          (map (lambda (c) (at g 2 c)) cs)))
         (gray (find-first
                (lambda (v) (and (!= v bg) (!= v body) (!= v tip)))
                (grid-colors g)))
         (ups (list)))
    (define (add r c v) (set! ups (cons (list r c v) ups)))
    (define (gray-rows c)
      (filter (lambda (r) (and (> r 2) (= (at g r c) gray))) (range h)))
    (for* ((c cs) (r (range 3))) (add r c bg))
    (for ((c cs))
      (let ((v (at g 2 c)) (hits (gray-rows c)))
        (if (= v tip)
            (let ((land (if (empty? hits) (- h 1) (- (first hits) 1))))
              (add (- land 2) c body)
              (add (- land 1) c body)
              (add land c tip))
            (let ((lc c))
              (when (and (not (empty? hits)) (>= (last hits) (- h 2)))
                (let* ((blob (connected-region
                              g (last hits) c
                              (lambda (r cc value) (= value gray)) 4))
                       (cnt (make-hash)))
                  (for ((cell blob))
                    (hash-update! cnt (second cell) add1 0))
                  (let* ((mx (apply max (hash-values cnt)))
                         (cands (filter (lambda (cc) (= (hash-ref cnt cc) mx))
                                        (hash-keys cnt))))
                    (set! lc (argmin
                              (lambda (cc) (+ (* 1000 (abs (- cc c))) cc))
                              cands))
                    (when (all? (lambda (n) (= n 1)) (hash-values cnt))
                      (let* ((r (first (first blob)))
                             (cols* (sort (hash-keys cnt) <))
                             (nl (count-where (lambda (cc) (< cc lc)) cols*))
                             (nr (count-where (lambda (cc) (> cc lc)) cols*))
                             (step (if (>= nr nl) 1 -1)))
                        (for ((k (range 1 (length cs))))
                          (let ((cc (+ lc (* step k))))
                            (when (and (in-bounds? r cc h w)
                                       (= (at g r cc) gray))
                              (add r cc bg)))))))))
              (for ((r (range (- h 3) h))) (add r lc body))))))
    (foldl (lambda (u out)
             (set-cell out (first u) (second u) (third u)))
           g (reverse ups))))
